problem: The existing one-time UAC launch path can fail when the local Python registration path depends on pywin32 or the staged launcher is incomplete, while RDC and the Desktop self-hosted runner are simultaneously unavailable.

solution.primary: Windows PowerShell 5.1 native COM Schedule.Service repair for the two existing governed tasks
solution.uac_activation: Self-elevates only the fixed repair script through Windows UAC

sdd_gate.evidence_contract: The repair must fail closed unless the existing local metadata, runtime root, immutable release root, source SHA, Python executable and run.py are valid. It may register only the fixed Broker and Watchdog tasks with their expected AtStartup, S4U and run-level contracts, and runtime recovery remains unproven until fresh runner pickup and RDC online evidence exist.
